description: SAGINAW, Mich. – State Senator-elect Chedrick Greene's resounding win in last week's special election for Michigan Senate District 35 is garnering national attention. In defeating his Republican opponent by nearly 20 points, Greene tripled now-Congresswoman Kristen McDonald Rivet’s margin of victory from 2022 when this seat was last on the ballot.
